simple.meaning: לוּא (lûwʼ) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a conditional particle; if ; by implication (interj. as a wish) would that!.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Genesis 17:18. The surrounding context includes family, death, land, wilderness, Egypt, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to לוּא (H3863) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: לוּא (lûwʼ) / H3863 is traced through Genesis 17:18, Genesis 23:13, Genesis 30:34, Genesis 50:15 with generated occurrence evidence.

definitions.short: a conditional particle; if ; by implication (interj. as a wish) would that!
definitions.usage: if (haply), peradventure, I pray thee, though, I would, would God (that).
definitions.full: H3863. lu לֻא 2Sam 18:12 Kt (Qr לוּ ) if: see לוּ . לאב (√ of following, compare Arabic (medial ) be thirsty , a stony tract of land (see Wetzst Reisebericht 99 )). לוּ 17 and לוּא ( 1Sam 14:30 ; Isa 48:18 ; 63:19 ), also לֻא (Qr לוּ ), 2Sam 18:12 ; 19:7 (Arabic , Aramaic , לְוַי , Mishna לְוַי , Assyrian lû , with optative force, Dl §§ 78 end, 93, 145 ; compare Kö ii. 333 ), conjunction if, O that : — 1 if (stating a case which has not been, or is not likely to be, realized): a. followed by perfect (so mostly), Deut 32:29 זאת ישׂכילו חכמו לו if they had been wise (which they are not), they would understand this; Micah 2:11 (apodosis וְהָיָה ); Judg 8:19 ; 13:23 י ׳חפץ לו לקח לא להמיתנו if J. had desired to slay us, he would not have taken, &c.; 1Sam 14:30 ; 2Sam 19:7 . b. followed by imperfect Ezek 14:15 if I were to send, &c. (but read probably אוֺ , compare 14:17 ; 14:19 ). c. followed by participle, 2Sam 18:12 שֹׁקֵל אָנֹכִי וְלֻא and though I should be weighing 1000 pieces of silver upon my hand, I would not, &c.; Psalm 81:14-17 לי שֹׁמֵעַ עמי לו if my people were hearkening to me, . . . quickly would I bow down, &c. d. followed by יֵשׁ Job 16:4 . — With the apodosis omitted, Gen 50:15 יִשְׂטְמֵנוּ לוּ if Joseph were to hate us (how should we fare then ?). 2 If only ...! i.e. O that! would that! (compare εἰ γάρ , εἴθε ) usually followed by perf., as Num 14:2 (twice in verse) מַתְנוּ לוּ if only we had died in the land of Egypt! 20:3 ; Josh 7:7 וַנֵּשֶׁב הוֺאַלְנוּ וְלוּ Isa 48:18 ; 63:19 ; followed by יֵשׁ Num 22:29 ; followed by imperfect Gen 17:18 יחיה לו O that Ishmael might live before thee! Job 6:2 ; followed by jussive Gen 30:34 יהי לו כדברך ; followed by imperative 23:13 שׁמעני לוּ אתה אם if thou — O that thou wouldst hear me! (+ probably 23:5 שׁמעני לוּ ׃ לאמר for שׁ ׃ לוֺ ׳לאמרֹ , and similarly 23:15 ). — Read also probably לֻא for Masoretic לֹא Judg 21:22 (with עַתָּה כִּי ), 1Sam 13:13 ; 20:14 (twice in verse); Job 9:33 (followed by יֵשׁ ); and perhaps 14:4 (Ew Kö).
